rationale: The implementation delta changes the transport cast from AsyncSocket to AsyncTransportWrapper and adds a CHECK that the cast succeeded. The Logic section does not mention either the concrete transport type or a validation/check of the cast. Its described operations—retrieving the pipeline, exiting if absent, deactivating transport, selecting an acceptor by hash, transferring to its event-base thread, attaching the socket, creating and registering a pipeline/connection, activating transport, and reading buffered data—are present in both versions.
